evidence.quote:
stage_inputs: |
                  One lane issues four Q/K TMA boxes. Threads 0..63 issue
                  predicated g/beta copies for all HeadsPerPrep heads, committing
                  one group per head. Warps 0..1 wait for their own copy groups
                  and join warps 4..5 at a 128-thread subset barrier. Warps 4..5
                  can then compute b/rho without waiting for Q/K; the other
                  warps acquire the Q/K transaction. The scan halves use
                  64-thread joins for the cross-half correction. For ratio 8
                  the local scans, corrections and rho writes are separate
                  passes across heads; ratios 1/2/3 finish one head at a time.
                  A CTA join completes this action before Gram work starts.

final_store: |
                  If requested, transpose the staged state to [value,key]
                  global order. Per thread prefetch one float4 into a register;
                  in each of VTT/8 rounds load the next float4 before storing
                  the current one. The last round has no next load and its
                  subsequently assigned current value is unused. No worktile
                  follows in this CTA, and no speculative future chunk remains.
                  Shared/global retirement follows kernel completion; no extra
                  store-drain operation is present in the source.

prepare: |
                  For nonempty Work, stage Q with zero padded heads and commit one copy group.
                  Use Q_shared when QHeads>0, otherwise alias ring slot zero as Q_ring.
                  If QPRE and Early=0, enqueue chunk c0 in slot zero before waiting for Q.
                  Initialize control state, then publish cached indices into IndexShared when present.
                  Each index store depends on its register load result; query issuance need not wait for it.
                  Wait leaving one group outstanding only in that pre-issued case, otherwise
                  wait all; a CTA barrier publishes Q, control and index storage and ends metadata reads.
                  If QPRE and Early=1, only now enqueue c0, even when the width disables index caching.
                  Cache the first QKS 16-wide Q slices in registers, duplicated across key groups.
                  When Q occupies ring slot zero, a CTA barrier after all Q fragment reads frees it.
                  Q_cached and any uncached Q_shared slices remain readable for the whole recurrence.
                  Zero Acc. For j=(1 if QPRE else 0)..Stages-2, enqueue c0+j into slot j
                  if it is below c1, otherwise commit an empty group.
                  Enqueueing a chunk resolves slot IDs in batches before issuing 16-byte row copies,
                  records validity and commits once; invalid slots still copy row zero of their pool.
                  Completion of prepare means Q is ready and priming is issued, not that KV is ready.
动作采用设计级粒度，而不是源码调用级粒度。两个连续动作之间，只有出现重要的数据发布、统计量捕获、资源归还、执行角色切换、独立循环或重叠机会，才值得拆开；没有这些边界的内部初始化、转换与计算可以合成一个已定义的动作。数学内部步骤由上游定义，地址计算、线程级 layout、指令语法及普通原语的实现细节交给 Coder。
多个 role 需要共同解释一个索引，或资源视图要用到它时，在 `domain` 中定义一次，各 role 写 `for(i)`。只在一个 role 内使用的索引直接写成局部范围 `for(j=0:2)`，不进 `domain`。域的边界能用上游名称表达时就引用名称，例如 chunk 数 `Nc`、每份工作的迭代数 `N`，不写算好的数字，以免上游规模改变后本区仍保留旧值。
`describe` 只保留特有且影响设计的内容，不是源码说明书；精确的 barrier 编号、寄存器编号、线程地址和普通 lowering 细节不进入本区。

evidence.quote:
finish_chunk: |
                  Each warp follows its own instruction sequence without a CTA
                  join between readout, state update, output sweep and entry
                  into final-state staging. On the full path, form valid BF16
                  Out rows in RhsOutput from QS and Qd/Uh, compute the R update
                  using preloaded Kc fragments and DU, and rebuild Rh. Then
                  perform a warp join and sweep only that warp's staged Out
                  bytes into contiguous 16-byte stores to Out and optional core.
                  On the mini branch, Out was already written by rhs; read
                  row-0 Kc after the DU0 join, perform the rank-1 R update and
                  rebuild Rh, without the full-path readout or sweep.
                  Nonfinal chunks have no trailing CTA join: the next advance
                  retires the prior shared reads before stage/RhsOutput reuse.
                  On the last chunk, if FinalState is requested, each warp
                  immediately writes its R values to stage 0 at FP32 pitch
                  VTT+1, then joins the CTA to publish the staged final state.
                  Full-path overlapping K/Q/V reads were retired by earlier
                  joins/preloads. In a final mini chunk with (c_n-1)%NSTAGE=0,
                  stage-0 writes can race other warps' outstanding Kc row-0
                  reads; the source supplies no read-retirement guarantee.
                  Keeping this suffix in one action does not order those reads
                  before other warps' writes. Output global stores may still
                  be in flight; the source adds no separate store-drain wait.

stage_partials: >-
                  After preparation writes and all old OperandArena readers and asynchronous fills have finished, nonempty valid
                  rows load MTail and form weighted FP32 numerators; empty splits stage zeros. Each valid row
                  writes D channels into the PartA view of OperandArena. Its 81920-byte operand capacity holds the 67584-byte
                  staging span including row spacing; padded rows are neither staged nor later read.
                  For Ng>0, the loop's current-slot transfer waits and QK/PV completion retire all old arena uses; the last group
                  enqueues no future transfer. For Ng=0 there are no K/V fills or matrix readers. A CTA barrier after staging
                  publishes the staged rows and joins final TMEM readouts; done includes this barrier.
                  Source limitation: the empty-split path lacks a pre-staging join for Query writers and can violate this reuse ordering.

evidence.quote:
release: >-
                  DotPair(n) joins the read completion of every epilogue row
                  and returns its TMEM pair slot; the final register FMA has
                  not yet executed. Staging(t,f) instead waits, through the
                  bulk source-read completion primitive, for every outstanding
                  earlier full-tile store to stop reading OutputStaging, then
                  rendezvous all epilogue members. The first full tile has no
                  earlier store to wait for. Tail tiles retain this store history.
                publish: >-
                  Output(t,f) converts F to BF16 in OutputStaging for a full
                  tile; all writers publish to the asynchronous access domain
                  and rendezvous before the elected store lane may proceed.
                store:
                  execution_mode: async
                  meaning: >-
                    Output(t,f) issues the two full-height 64-column bulk
                    transfers to the owned out region and commits them as one
                    group. Done means global writes are complete. The next
                    worktile may start while these writes remain in flight.

store_tail: >-
                  out(t,z) converts and directly stores only rows u<V;
                  discarded rows do not write, and OutputStaging and prior
                  bulk-store history remain untouched. F is no longer read
                  when this action completes.
                drain: >-
                  Stores waits for global completion of all previously issued
                  bulk-store groups, or has no data effect when none were issued.
                  The final CTA rendezvous and ProductRing deallocation follow
                  role completion, including for workers with no worktiles.

drain: Copies(t) waits for every committed copy group to finish, including the final empty groups,
                  and rendezvous the CTA. InputRing is then free of input readers and in-flight writes.
                publish: Convert the entire final F to BF16 in Output(t), using the first InputRing slot after drain.
                  This view holds the Bm-by-Bn block plus implementation row padding, within that slot's capacity.
                  A CTA rendezvous makes every staged row readable. Schedule remains disjoint and live.
                store: Cooperatively read Output(t) and issue ordinary vector stores to the owned out region for rows
                  u<V only. Done includes the trailing CTA rendezvous and ends all staging reads, permitting the next
                  worktile to overwrite InputRing. Destination writes are covered by main.kernel_done; no host synchronization
                  or separate asynchronous bulk-store queue is introduced.

| 搬运访存 | `load`    | 从绑定的源读取既有值到指定目标                           | 本次源读取结束，目标数据可用；不自动归还源使用权                   |
| 搬运访存 | `store`   | 把已有值写入绑定的目标                                   | 目标写入完成，并满足声明的消费者所需的可见性                       |
| 顺序同步 | `await`   | 等待其他参与者的已声明通知条件，可涉及多个通知           | 声明的条件及其交接保证已满足                                       |
| 顺序同步 | `signal`  | 向声明的参与者发出指定含义的通知                         | 本方通知义务完成，不表示对方已经继续                               |
| 资源占用 | `acquire` | 取得指定资源本次使用所需的资格                           | 已实际取得使用资格，仅发出请求不算完成                             |
| 资源占用 | `release` | 归还本参与者对指定资源或区域的使用权                     | 本参与者已结束该部分使用；不代表所有参与者完成，也不必物理销毁资源 |

                publish: |
                  Alpha(n) updates M and publishes all row scales before exponentiation.
                  P(n) copies PackedRegisters into its aliased TMEM view and completes
                  its writes before publication. The two-slot scale relay is safe
                  because the QK(n+2) completion preceding its next write follows

                compute: Weights(n) performs the weights rewrite after Alpha publication, retains packed P in registers and advances D.

                  Final(w) captures Fsum,Fmax on the last tile. For short requests,

mma: |
                  P(n)@VTile(n) performs the value_state rewrite into Y. First PV
                  initializes Y; later PV follows correction. Products issue in
                  one ordered tensor stream, and a completion notification covers
                  all earlier products. Earlier PV reads of an aliased P slot
                  finish before a later QK overwrites that slot. This ordering also
                  protects the tiny reread before the same S slot can recur.
                  PV completion releases its K/V slot. For KVSlots=3 the release
                  notification cycles with the three S/P slots; for KVSlots=4 it
                  additionally cycles with the four K/V slots, preventing parity aliasing.

noun 是这个 role 作用域里的对象名称，不是全局数学值或物理分配的登记。不同 role、不同 verb 可以使用同名 noun；`compute:P` 与 `store:P` 各有自己的模式和说明。同名只有在描述的对象、版本及范围一致时才指同一个东西，不能仅靠拼写认定。

- 同一 `(role, verb, noun)` 基名只允许一种固定参数个数；复合动作分别检查各操作数。`P` 与 `P(i)` 不在同一动作族中混用，不按参数数量或常量索引重载。
- 从 pipe 核对全部调用，包括空域和未执行分支中的动作；`waiting` 的引用必须匹配相同动作族及参数个数。
- `A(i)@B(j)` 是否允许、是否要求 `i=j`，由实际数学与索引关系决定，不能从声明键推导。声明不建立循环域、不生成动作，也不改变索引作用域。
- 动作实例由 phase、worker 实例、成员、role、verb、noun 及实际参数共同确定，展开后必须唯一。重复动作要带足够的真实轮次、版本或区域索引；不能靠源码行、控制块位置或未声明的阶段区分同名事件。

##### `describe` 要说明什么

最少要让读者确定「对象是什么、本动作做什么」。上游已经明确的公式、精度、工作范围直接沿用，用普通对象名和步骤名说明对应关系，不重抄整份算法。以下几项无法唯一确定，必须在本条目写清：

- **跨动作的输入**：本动作读取的每个值，连同它的版本／区域／副本，以及来源动作和成员。入口值和跨 phase 输入注明对应来源。本 role 自己的异步产物和控制条件同样要列。
- **存储绑定**：读写已登记存储时点名对应的 `resource` 与 `view`。`view` 唯一定义区域与存储解释，`describe` 只绑定本次访问，不得重新定义该 view。同名 noun 不建立绑定：同一个 P 既在 TMEM 又在寄存器时，各自的动作必须分别指明分配。
特定原语的顺序保证可以代替一条显式的边，例如同一 role 中先发起的矩阵乘读完一块存储之后，后发起的矩阵乘才写入它。依赖这种保证时，在 `describe` 中写明保证本身及其适用范围；不能从 `execution_mode`、同一个 role 名或同一个 noun 名推出硬件会处理冲突。

对于同一 phase 内的局部动作，**唯一不写也成立的依赖是：role 内按 pipe 顺序与各动作的 `execution_mode` 推进。** 其余局部依赖都要显式写出，包括操作数就绪、矩阵乘的产物交给谁、动作读了 noun 名字里没有的值、存储何时可以覆盖、协议何时放行。跨 phase 数据交接按 [work_schedule.flow.handoff 的默认等待及 `ready / wait_at` 规则](4.design.work_schedule.md#交接字段)执行。

已由 role 顺序、`async_ordered` 的累积完成或其他边传递保证的前驱可以省略——省略的是可推导的重复前驱，不是必要的就绪条件。

输入与前驱按以下要求核对：

- 每个 noun 的 `describe` 必须逐项列明本动作的跨动作输入，连同版本／区域／副本及来源动作和成员；入口值与跨 phase 输入注明对应来源，本 role 自己的异步产物和控制条件同样要列。
- Reviewer 先对照上游数学与 `describe` 核对输入完整性，再逐项核对从就绪到实际读取的安全保证。允许由执行模式、`waiting` 的传递路径或明确绑定的原语保证覆盖，不要求每一项都有一条直边。

retire: >-
                  Previous(g) waits for PV(g-1) when g>cLo; at g=cLo it is a
                  no-op with no previous accumulator or operand reads.
                  A real wait observes the committed PV phase, advances its parity
                  once and applies the after-thread-sync fence. It proves all
                  reads of that PV's Value, ValueScale and Prob8 are finished and
                  its NumState updates are complete. Previous occurs
                  after both current QK halves, allowing PV to overlap their
                  preparation and readout.
                advance: >-
                  Apply normalize and the numerator rescale using the retained

| 类别     | 动作词      | 含义                                                     | `done` 保证                                                      |
| -------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 数值计算 | `compute` | 按上游定义执行逐元素、归约、转换等非矩阵乘类运算         | 指定结果可供声明的消费者使用                                       |
| 数值计算 | `matmul`  | 执行上游定义的矩阵乘法及其累加；公式与数值路径由上游确定 | 指定矩阵结果可供声明的消费者使用                                   |
| 搬运访存 | `load`    | 从绑定的源读取既有值到指定目标                           | 本次源读取结束，目标数据可用；不自动归还源使用权                   |
| 搬运访存 | `store`   | 把已有值写入绑定的目标                                   | 目标写入完成，并满足声明的消费者所需的可见性                       |
| 顺序同步 | `await`   | 等待其他参与者的已声明通知条件，可涉及多个通知           | 声明的条件及其交接保证已满足                                       |
| 顺序同步 | `signal`  | 向声明的参与者发出指定含义的通知                         | 本方通知义务完成，不表示对方已经继续                               |
| 资源占用 | `acquire` | 取得指定资源本次使用所需的资格                           | 已实际取得使用资格，仅发出请求不算完成                             |
| 资源占用 | `release` | 归还本参与者对指定资源或区域的使用权                     | 本参与者已结束该部分使用；不代表所有参与者完成，也不必物理销毁资源 |

| `serial`          | 自身 `done` 之后，才能发起后续动作；不自动排空此前其他异步动作                                              |
| `async_unordered` | 按 pipe 顺序发起，后续动作不必等自身 `done`；不提供动作之间的完成顺序                                       |
| `async_ordered`   | 按 pipe 顺序发起并允许重叠；采用该模式的动作按发起顺序累积完成，后一个 `done` 覆盖该序列此前动作的 `done` |

`async_ordered` 中的 ordered **只指 `done` 的累积覆盖**，不指发起顺序——两种异步模式的发起顺序都由 pipe 列表决定。累积完成**跨 noun、跨 verb**，并跨循环与 worktile 接续；中间的 `serial` 动作不重置该序列，其他 `async_unordered` 动作不被纳入。不能为每个 noun 暗中建立一条独立的完成队列。

只有原语确实提供上述共同保证时才采用 `async_ordered`。**两个引擎各自有序不等于共同有序**：同一 role 中若存在互不覆盖的完成机制，使用 `async_unordered`，并通过 `waiting` 表达需要的先后。完成依据本身不足时按[缺项规则](../schema_template/README.md#1-确认资料与范围)处理，不靠改模式或补等待假定已有实现提供了保证。累积完成本身不提供操作数就绪、别名覆盖安全或提前归还源缓冲的保证。

| `.wait_at`     | 消费者里程碑引用或非空引用列表                                                | 消费者可以先做独立工作、稍后才等待该值时填写   | 覆盖默认的消费入口等待；每条引用自带所属 phase                  |

省略 `ready` 表示相应生产 worktile 完成、且交出的区域已满足消费者所需的可见性；省略 `wait_at` 表示消费 worktile 开始前该区域必须就绪。这两条是设计约束，不会自动生成发布标志、跨 CTA barrier 或轮询协议，相应机制由 [tile_pipeline](5.design.tile_pipeline.md#跨-phase-交接) 给出。

显式 `wait_at` 通过消费者里程碑定位数据必须就绪的事件：可以是等待动作的 `done`，或真正读取动作的 `issue`。等待本身可以提前开始，其 `issue` 不表示数据已就绪。

`storage` 写 `global` 只规定全局物化，不规定分配 API、物理地址或分配器所有权；写资源引用时，存储空间、所属 worker、容量和槽数由该资源的定义提供，本区不复制。

| `kernel_done`  | 该 phase 所属计算 kernel 完成，且交出的结果满足后继执行所需的可见性                                                                        |
| `launch_ready` | 启动协议定义的后继启动许可事件，针对整个前驱 grid，不是某份 worktile 的数据就绪                                                            |
| 其他名称         | `tile_pipeline` 在该 phase 的 `milestone` 中定义的里程碑，例如某个值第一次被读取的位置；必须能确定作用域、工作索引和相关数据的使用位置 |

同一次提交内的各 phase 共享一个 `kernel_done`：引用其中任何一个 phase 的 `kernel_done`，指的都是这次提交的完成，不是该 phase 的局部完成点。`start_after` 约束设备执行何时可以开始，不要求 host 线程阻塞；一次提交不能等待自己的 `kernel_done`，跨提交的启动依赖也不能形成没有初始事件的循环。

跨 phase 的交接由 [work_schedule.flow.handoff](4.design.work_schedule.md#跨-phase-数据交接) 登记，默认交接点遵循该区规则。本区只为上游要求提前交出或推迟等待的时点定义 `milestone`，上游以 `<phase_id>.<milestone>` 引用；交接发生在片上资源中时，上游引用本区定义的资源。

`milestone` 只给已有的事件组起一个对外名称，所列事件全部发生时成立；它不产生数据可见性、跨 CTA 通知或轮询，这些机制由 role 中的实际动作承担。`kernel_done` 与 `launch_ready` 是第 4 篇定义的内建事件，不能作为局部里程碑重新定义，也不能通过添加索引来重定义。

里程碑的键可以带索引，如 `snapshot_ready(c)`，索引与所引用事件中的同名索引对应。生产侧的里程碑绑定真实的完成或发布事件；消费侧按 [`wait_at` 规则](4.design.work_schedule.md#交接字段)绑定实际等待或读取事件。

thesis: |-
      Fork after the caller's preceding work, run the full-batch probe on a side stream
      and a packed prefix on the caller stream, then submit the accepted packed remainder
      behind the probe. The remainder need not wait for the prefix. Queue a side-to-caller
      join after the remainder and behind the prefix, so subsequent caller work observes
      all output rows. One probe and two attention launches
      plus the event pair permit overlap without promising simultaneous residency.
    flow:
      launch:
      - phase: [probe]
      - phase: [prefix]
      - phase: [remainder]
        start_after: probe.kernel_done
    phase:
      probe:
        describe: |-
          The caller first records a fork after its prior work; the side stream waits for
          that fork before reading input tensors. The host arms the mapped slots with -2
          and submits this full-batch probe to the side stream. It then submits prefix to
          the caller stream before polling at most 2000000 passes, stopping when a pass
          finds no -2. The final scan reads each slot once and computes probe's positive-only
          R. This node accepts packing and submits remainder using the initial P parameters.
          Polling may finish before probe.kernel_done. Side-stream order still prevents
          remainder from starting before probe completion; prefix has no probe completion
          wait. ProbeRatio is consumed only by the host, not by either attention kernel,
          so no tensor handoff connects these phases. ProbeCount follows probe's actual
          update order and can differ from the attention union count. The source also permits
          pending probe writes to race a later gate reset; selection uses the actual observed R.

describe: |-
          Build packed unions and write outputs for the remaining groups on the side stream.
          After this kernel, record the join on the side stream and queue its wait on the
          caller stream behind prefix. The join covers remainder.kernel_done, which also
          follows probe.kernel_done; caller order covers prefix.kernel_done. Return does
          not block the host for either output producer. The join is an external completion
          boundary, not a fourth compute kernel or an output merge.

choice: |
        Model.forward caches workspace selection by argument identity; a non-CUDA or
        smaller-than-32-MiB workspace selects cached private scratch. dsv4_run allocates larger scratch
        if P.ws_bytes exceeds the selected capacity. The two-kernel flow uses the current
        CUDA stream, directly or through the process-wide single-entry CUDA Graph cache.
        Graph eligibility requires P.ws_bytes<=W in this node. Its key includes the ten
        tensor pointers, dimensions, scales, plan and extension switches. A changed key
        invalidates the old entry and submits directly. Repeating the last eligible key
        synchronizes the caller stream before capturing dispatch on a private stream,
        then instantiates and launches the graph on the caller stream. An executable key
        hit replays without that capture synchronization.

        Begin-capture failure returns before dispatch; failed capture or instantiation executes
        none of the recorded kernels. Graph failure disables graph use for the process and
        falls through to direct dispatch; it creates no additional completion guarantee.

`retention` 描述逻辑用途，不是内存空间枚举：递推状态一律写 `carry_forward`，它是否需要在某处保存到全局内存不由这个词决定；`keep_value` 也不表示全局内存、独立 kernel 或屏障，值放在哪一级存储由下游决定（跨 phase 交接时见 `work_schedule` 的 `handoff.storage`）。初值、重置位置、有效迭代范围、消费者和最终输出关系都由 `math` 给出，本区不另设初始化、重置或终点字段；`retention` 必须与这些公式一致。

这里的“迭代”以 `math` 定义的计算和逻辑实例为准。例如，输入的切片或排列视图可以在一份 worktile 中保持不变，由下游缓存供多轮计算使用；单凭这种物理驻留不能判定新增了逻辑物化。若数学设计要求保留非递推的值，供后续迭代或步骤复用而不重算，则按该逻辑实例填写 `keep_value`。

`keep_value` 不要求每个元素恰好写一次，也不要求本次调用覆盖所有槽。某个空分支保留已有 scratch 内容时，由 `math` 写明哪些元素保持不变，不能从保留方式推导额外写入。

evidence.quote:
wait: &drain_wait
                  execution_mode: serial
                  meaning: >-
                    Hoist=1 when R>=16*E, otherwise Hoist=0. Drain(t,q) completes
                    after its explicit predecessors; q identifies the optional
                    wait before the first scale copy of a worktile.
                prepare: &scale_prepare >-
                  The elected issuer waits for the full-stage protocol and copies
                  AScale and BScale into ScaleTM: four scale-copy operations for each
                  operand. Issuance includes submission of all scale copies;
                  only then does this issuer advance to the MMA action. Done is covered
                  by the following cumulative MMA completion.
                mma: >-
                  Consume PayloadA/PayloadB and ScaleTM in four ordered 64-channel
                  block-scaled updates to C1. The first update initializes C1 without
                  reading its old value. The fused 128-column product covers both up
                  and gate. Issue a cumulative completion commit after each stage;
                  done covers scale copies, payload reads and accumulator updates.
                  The last stage also commits result readiness for the epilogue.
                  Same-issuer ordering ensures an earlier MMA has consumed ScaleTM
                  before a later scale copy overwrites that scale slot, and makes each
                  scale copy visible before the MMA that uses it.
                retire: {execution_mode: serial, meaning: *gemm_retire}
            pipe:
              repeat: t
              prologue: ["enter:Protocol"]
              steady:
                - repeat: {q: [0, "min(1,t)*(1-Hoist)"]}
                  steady: ["wait:Drain(t,q)"]
                - repeat: "g[t]"
                  steady: ["prepare:ScaleTM(g)", "mma:PayloadA(g)@PayloadB(g)"]
              epilogue: ["retire:TensorStorage"]
            waits_for:
              data:
                "prepare:ScaleTM(g)": ["AProducer/publish:AScale(g)", "BProducer/load:PayloadPair(g)", "BProducer/stage:BScale(g)"]
              reuse:
                "wait:Drain(t,q)@done": &prior_drain ["Epilogue/release:Accumulator(t-1)", "Epilogue0/release:Accumulator(t-1)", "Epilogue1/release:Accumulator(t-1)", "Epilogue2/release:Accumulator(t-1)"]
                "mma:PayloadA(g[t,0])@PayloadB(g[t,0])": *prior_drain

release: &acc_release >-
                  This warp arrives once after its last TMEM-read wait and warp
                  rendezvous. Done releases only this warp's accumulator quadrant;
                  MMA reuse waits for all four epilogue roles. This warp immediately
                  continues its final conversion/store tail without waiting for the
                  other epilogue warps or for global output-store completion.
                retire: *gemm_retire
            pipe: &fc1_epi_pipe
              repeat: t
              prologue: ["enter:Protocol"]
              steady: ["drain:Fragment(t,0)", "emit:ActQ(t,0)", "drain:Fragment(t,1)", "release:Accumulator(t)", "emit:ActQ(t,1)"]
              epilogue: ["retire:TensorStorage"]
            waits_for: &fc1_epi_wait
              data:
                "drain:Fragment(t,0)": ["MMA/mma:PayloadA(g[t,last(i)])@PayloadB(g[t,last(i)])"]
          Epilogue0:
            info:
              execution_mode: serial
              member: "warp[4:5]"
              verb: *fc1_epi_verb
            pipe: *fc1_epi_pipe
            waits_for: *fc1_epi_wait
          Epilogue1:
            info:
              execution_mode: serial
              member: "warp[5:6]"
              verb: *fc1_epi_verb
            pipe: *fc1_epi_pipe
            waits_for: *fc1_epi_wait
          Epilogue2:
            info:
              execution_mode: serial
              member: "warp[6:7]"
              verb: *fc1_epi_verb
            pipe: *fc1_epi_pipe

**省略成员下标一律指当前 worker 成员**，带 role 名也一样；当前成员上没有该 role 时，不能自动改取其他成员或全部成员。这里的成员来自 worker 组成，**不是 warp 编号**。跨成员的关系必须写出明确编号或 `[*]`，不根据双方 role 的布局自动改变含义。引用仍须指向所选成员上实际存在的动作。

`waiting` 左侧必须属于当前 role，右侧可以引用同一 phase 的任何 role，包括当前 role；跨 phase 的关系经由上游的 `handoff` 和本区的 `milestone` 连接，`::` 不提供跨 phase 寻址。
